source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting a failed industrial safety audit

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Identify the specific areas or items that failed to meet the safety standards as outlined in the audit checklist. Take detailed notes on the observations made by the auditor, including the exact regulations violated.

3. Gather supporting evidence.
Take photographs or record descriptions of the unsafe conditions identified during the audit, such as faulty equipment, improper signage, or inadequate personal protective equipment (PPE). This evidence will support the audit findings and assist in creating a clear picture of the issues for future reference.

4. Assemble audit documents.
Compile all documentation that was used or referenced during the audit, including the audit checklist, standard operating procedures, and relevant safety policies. Maintain these documents along with the audit report as part of the official record.

5. Detail areas of non-compliance.
Identify each specific area where non-compliance was noted. For every point of failure, reference the corresponding standard or regulation. Provide a detailed description of the non-compliance, including any immediate hazards
